bio_en: Yeghishe Pahlavuni was born in 1884 in Igdir in the Surmalu district, into a family whose home was a refuge for fedayi travelling to and from the homeland. He trained at a military school as a cadet and in 1904-06 worked in the Balakhani workers' circle in Baku. In the First World War he served first in Andranik's force and then in Ishkhan's, fighting under Ishkhan and Keri as a company commander in Western Armenia in 1914-16, and later in the 20th battalion that protected refugees. He died on 3 February of an unstated year after a long illness.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Year of death not read; 'Ishkhan' here is Hovsep Arghutian.
